### When the Clinic Never Sleeps

The scrub tech had already used the autoclave to [sterilize]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="sterilize · vt. 消毒；使无菌; 使失去生育能力；使绝育; 使成不毛之地；使贫瘠化; 消毒者，消毒器"} every instrument, each one gleaming under the theatre lights. On the counter sat amber bottles of [antibiotics]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="antibiotics · n. 抗生素; 抗生物质的研究"} and a rack of daily [supplement]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="supplement · n. 增补；补品；增刊；附录；额外服务费用；补角 增补，补充"} capsules — fish oil, vitamin D, the modest artillery of preventive care. Cultures from the respiratory ward came back: the pathogen was susceptible to the [antibiotics]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="antibiotics · n. 抗生素; 抗生物质的研究"} already running. ### When the Body Keeps the Score

Dr. Ferris had spent thirty years in medicine, yet no single morning shift ever felt routine. By 7 a.m. the ward was already alive with [respiration]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="respiration · n. 呼吸, 一次呼吸; 呼吸"} monitors beeping softly above beds where [convalescent]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="convalescent · adj. 恢复的,康复期的; 恢复期的病人"} patients dozed, their bodies slowly reclaiming ground lost to illness.

His first consult was a retired teacher whose [degenerative]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="degenerative · adj. 退步的,变质的,退化的"} joint disease had sent her to a [chiropractor]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="chiropractor · n. 脊椎推拿治疗者"} for months before anyone thought to image her spine. [Chiropractic]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="chiropractic · n. 脊椎推拿疗法"} had eased the pain temporarily, but the scans told a harder story. Down the hall, a young father complained of crushing chest pressure; the [cardiologist]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="cardiologist · n. 心脏病专家"} on call ordered an echo and found [ventricular]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="ventricular · adj. 心室的,膨胀的"} wall motion abnormalities — stress, poor sleep, and a diet built on convenience had quietly done their work. A third patient, a woman in her forties, had presented overnight with acute [appendicitis]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="appendicitis · n. 阑尾炎"}; she was post-op now, draining well, the [disinfectant]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="disinfectant · n. 消毒剂, 杀菌剂"} smell still sharp around her bay.

The paediatric corner held its own dramas. A six-month-old had arrived feverish and [constipated]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="constipated · adj. 患便秘的"}, his onesie raw with [diaper rash]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="diaper rash 尿疹"}, the parents hollow-eyed from three nights without sleep. The nurse hung a saline drip to reverse early [dehydration]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="dehydration · n. 脱水; 干燥;极度口渴"} while the resident explained the [respiratory]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="respiratory · adj. 呼吸的,呼吸用的"} precautions still in place since the last [coronavirus]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="coronavirus · n. 日冕形病毒,冠状病毒"} surge had overwhelmed the unit. Nearby, a toddler who had swallowed a handful of berries showed signs of [disseminated]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="disseminated 弥散性"} toxin — [epinephrine]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="epinephrine · n. 肾上腺素"} drawn and ready at the bedside.

Afternoon brought the subspecialists. The [optometrist]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="optometrist · n. 验光师,视力测定者"} from the eye clinic stopped by to screen the diabetic patients; [nephropathy]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="nephropathy · n. 肾病"} and retinopathy so often travelled together that joint rounds had become standard. A fellow from [epidemiology]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="epidemiology · n. 流行病学"} sat in the corner, tracing a cluster of unusual fevers, noting each [coindication]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="coindication · n. 征兆之一"} in a spreadsheet that would eventually feed a model. One elderly gentleman — a patient of the [gerontology]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="gerontology · n. 老年医学,老人学"} service — had been admitted for [hypothermia]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="hypothermia · n. 低体温"} after a cold snap caught him underdressed; he was warming steadily, though his [hypothalamic]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="hypothalamic · adj. 丘脑下部的,下丘脑的"} temperature regulation remained sluggish.

By late afternoon the surgical list had grown. A [fasciectomy]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="fasciectomy 筋膜切除术"} was booked for a construction worker whose scarred fascia had been strangling the muscles of his forearm for years. The hepatobiliary team debated whether a stone-filled [gallbladder]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="gallbladder · n. 胆囊"} warranted urgent removal or could wait until the patient's [indigestion]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="indigestion · n. 消化不良"} was better controlled. A couple sat in the counselling room while a specialist walked them through options for [infertility]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="infertility · n. 不肥沃,不毛"} — the husband's [dysfunction]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="dysfunction · n. 机能障碍,机能失调"} had a correctable hormonal cause, which was, for once, genuinely good news.

At shift change, Dr. Ferris glanced at a history textbook left open on the nursing station: a woodcut of medieval [bloodletting]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="bloodletting · n. 放血"}, the caption noting that physicians once drained patients to rebalance their humours. He thought of the [haemorrhoid]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="haemorrhoid · n. 痔"} clinic running downstairs, of the epidemiology fellow's spreadsheet, of all the ways the body still managed to surprise — and confound — those who had devoted their lives to understanding it.

### A Long Day at the Teaching Hospital

The morning began with a [prescription]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="prescription · n. 药, 治疗方法; 处方, 药方; 开处方, 开药"} the attending physician had scrawled at midnight — a [tranquilizing]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="tranquilizing 镇静"} dose intended to ease a restless post-operative patient whose body remained [susceptible to]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="susceptible to · adj. 对...敏感的，易受...感动的, 易为...感染的"} every noise on the ward. By seven, the [pediatrician]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="pediatrician · n. 小儿科医师"} was already on the floor, crouching beside a toddler whose [malnourished]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="malnourished · adj. 营养失调的,营养不良的"} frame and vacant eyes hinted at months of inadequate feeding at home. Beside him, the [obstetrician]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="obstetrician · n. 产科医师"} reviewed an ultrasound report: [amniocentesis]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="amniocentesis · n. 羊膜穿刺术"} results had come back positive for [Down syndrome]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="down syndrome 唐氏症 Down syndrome唐氏综合征"}, a conversation no parent was ever prepared to have.

In the adjacent bay, a young woman lay still, a [kidney stone]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="kidney stone · n. 肾结石"} having [incapacitated]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="incapacitate · vt. 使无能力,使不适合"} her through the night — the [incapacitation]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="incapacitation · n. 无能力,使无能力,使无资格"} written plainly on her face even after the pain relief drip was set. A resident flipped through her chart and noted a prior [inflammation]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="inflammation · n. 炎症"} of the renal pelvis, its cause still murky. Down the corridor, the [dermatologist]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="dermatologist · n. 皮肤病学家"} conferred with the [ophthalmology]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="ophthalmology · n. 眼科学"} team over a patient whose [hepatocellular]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="hepatocellular · adj. 肝细胞的"} markers were climbing and whose skin had begun to show the tell-tale yellowing that linked eye and liver in one grim picture.

The afternoon belonged to the teaching rounds. A medical student presented a case of [intoxication]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="intoxication · n. 陶醉"} from an over-the-counter decongestant — the patient had reached for the bottle with the [inflammatory]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="inflammatory · adj. 刺激性的;煽动性的; 炎性的;发炎的"} confidence of someone who believed more was better. The pharmacologist walked the group through [therapeutics]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="therapeutics · n. 治疗学,疗法"}: how [immunotherapy]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="immunotherapy · n. 免疫疗法"} was reshaping oncology, how [anticholinergic]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="anticholinergic · adj. 反副交感神经生理作用的"} agents could confuse an elderly nervous system in minutes, how the [accessory nerve]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="accessory nerve 副神经"} could be nicked during a neck dissection if the surgeon's anatomy was careless. Someone raised the [placebo effect]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="placebo effect · n. 安慰剂效果"} — whether it had a measurable role in [anesthetization]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="anesthetization · n. 麻醉,麻痹"} protocols — and the room fell into the comfortable argument that teaching hospitals run on.

Later, the gynecology fellow explained [progesterone]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="progesterone · n. 孕酮,黄体酮"} supplementation to a woman whose [menstruation]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="menstruation · n. 月经;行经;月经期间"} had been irregular for a year, and briefly touched on [contraceptive]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="contraceptive · adj. 避孕的,避孕用的; 避孕药,避孕用具"} options post-delivery. In the corner office, a nurse documented a patient's heightened [susceptibility]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="susceptibility · n. 敏感性；感情；磁化系数"} to latex, flagging it before the next procedure. Outside the window, a man who had clearly been [nymphomaniac]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="nymphomaniac · n. 慕男狂患者,女色情狂"} in his lifestyle choices — the notes were blunt — waited for the [implantation]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="implantation · n. 培植,灌输"} of a cardiac monitor, his chart a catalogue of preventable damage.

Before the shift ended, a second-year resident learned, in the quietest way, that medicine is not about having every answer. It is about staying in the room long enough to ask the right question — and occasionally, when all else fails, resisting the urge to [hock a loogie]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="hock a loogie"} in the on-call bathroom mirror and pretending you are not exhausted.

### A Day at the Eye Clinic — and the Body's Long Paper Trail

The waiting room of the city's leading [ophthalmologist]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="ophthalmologist · n. 眼科专家,眼科医师"} smelled faintly of antiseptic. A teenager slumped in the corner, clearly [under the weather]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="under the weather 人不太舒服；身体不适"}, scrolling through his phone with the glazed look of someone who had not slept. His mother whispered that he had woken up with [Nasal congestion]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="Nasal congestion"} and a low fever, yet she had dragged him here anyway because his vision had been blurring for weeks.

Across the room, a neurologist from the same building paused to chat with the receptionist. Down the corridor, a pharmacist restocked a cabinet of [pharmaceuticals]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="pharmaceuticals · n. 医药品"} while a drug-education poster warned teenagers about [methamphetamine]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="methamphetamine · n. 甲基苯丙胺,脱氧麻黄碱"} and, in smaller print, about the misuse of [methylphenidate]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="methylphenidate · n. 利他灵"} — two stimulants that shared a structural family tree yet sat on opposite ends of the prescription ledger. Next to the poster was a flyer for an [aversion therapy]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="aversion therapy 厌恶疗法"} programme targeting substance dependence, run by the hospital's psychiatry unit. A urologist passed by, heading to a consultation about [erectile dysfunction]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="erectile dysfunction 勃起功能障碍"} in a middle-aged patient whose chart also flagged a possible [pathogenic retinue]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="pathogenic retinue"} of gut bacteria thought to be disrupting his hormonal baseline.
